newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Taiwan's Bank SinoPac FRCD increased to US$75 mln.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Bank SinoPac FRCD increased to US$75 mln.

text.p: Bank SinoPac's floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been increased to US$75 million from US$60 million, bookrunner Merrill Lynch International said Tuesday.
The three-year issue, which was launched through the bank's offshore banking unit, was priced at par to float at 20 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 26 basis points.
Arranger and lead manager Merrill Lynch International committed US$12 million.
Co-arrangers, with US$10 million each, are Banque Nationale de Paris and Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK).
Senior co-lead manager Land Bank of Taiwan committed US$10 million.
Co-lead manager Hua Nan Commercial Bank's Singapore branch committed US$6 million.

Co-managers are Development Bank of Singapore's Taipei Offshore Banking unit, First Chicago Hongkong and Taiwan Cooperative Bank's Offshore Banking branch, with US$5 million each, and Banca Nazionale del Lavoro's Singapore branch, Commerz (East Asia), International Commercial Bank of China's Paris branch and National Bank of Abu Dhabi, with US$3 million each.
